# About MENASCO

> For more than three decades, MENASCO has delivered integrated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) engineering solutions that power some of the region's most demanding developments, from Dubai's skyline to mission-critical facilities across the globe. Through technical expertise and disciplined project execution, we create reliable infrastructure that stands the test of time.

## Company Overview

MENASCO Mechanical Contracting LLC is one of MENA's leading providers of integrated MEP engineering and contracting solutions, delivering high-performance building services across commercial, residential, hospitality, energy, healthcare, and mission-critical developments.

Founded in 1994, MENASCO has earned a reputation for engineering precision, technical excellence, and reliable project delivery. Today, our footprint spans seven global locations, allowing us to support clients across MENA, Europe, and North America with consistent quality, innovation, and operational excellence.

Our multidisciplinary teams combine engineering expertise, advanced technologies, and collaborative project management to deliver complete lifecycle MEP solutions, from design coordination and BIM integration through installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.

## Key Facts

- Established in 1994 in the UAE as MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C.
- Operates as an integrated MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection) engineering and contracting company.
- 350+ Projects Successfully Delivered
- 32+ Years of Engineering Excellence
- 4 Countries of Operation (United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, United Kingdom)
- Dubai, UAE is MENASCO’s Head Office.
- Regional offices in Riyadh (MENASCO KSA), Cairo (MENASCO Misr), London (United Kingdom).
- Serves sectors including Residential / Commercial, Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment, Advanced Technical Facilities.
- Core service lines include Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, BIM & Digital Engineering, Manufacturing & Prefabrication, alongside dedicated data centre MEP delivery.
- Delivers specialist engineering for data centres, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and other technically demanding facilities.
- Project-delivery approach incorporates early project engagement, BIM-driven coordination, and disciplined execution.
- Maintains a dedicated Innovation & Technology ecosystem spanning Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS), LYNX, AI Engineering, MENASCO Connect.
- Maintains an integrated QHSE system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018.

## Mission

To deliver MEP engineering that powers our collective future: innovative in method, uncompromising in quality, and honest in every commitment we make.

## Vision

To be the MEP partner the world turns to when failure is not an option.

## Values

- Innovation: Transforming visionary ideas into practical engineering solutions.
- Integrity: Acting with honesty, transparency, and professionalism in everything we do.
- Excellence: Pursuing exceptional quality in every project, every system, and every detail.
